def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()  # Maps key -> (value, write_time)
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries (check all entries)
            expired_keys = [k for k, (v, write_time) in cache.items() if write_time + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will re-add at end)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is full and key is new, evict LRU
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                cache.popitem(last=False)  # Remove first (LRU) item
            
            # Add/update the entry
            cache[key] = (value, t)
            # Move to end (most recently used)
            cache.move_to_end(key)
            
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries (check all entries)
            expired_keys = [k for k, (v, write_time) in cache.items() if write_time + ttl <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
            
            # Check if key exists and is not expired
            if key in cache:
                value, write_time = cache[key]
                results.append(value)
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
